action.label: Quick throw body
action.poses: 1 alert ready; 2 RIGHT elbow draws back above shoulder, LEFT arm points screen-right for aim; 3 snap RIGHT arm forward towards screen-right in a clear overhand throwing release with fingers opening; 4 right arm follows diagonally down across torso, weight onto front foot; 5 return alert ready. No thrown object, stone, knife, projectile or trail. A quick ranged utility throw gesture, not bow draw or a boxing jab.
action.scope: Body-only animation; no weapon/projectile/VFX runtime implemented
